{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify the population size: should be 800 unique patients
assert len(df_dedup) == 800, f'Expected 800 patients, got {len(df_dedup)}'

# Check arm distribution
treatment_count = len(df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment'])
control_count = len(df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'control'])

# Compute response rates
treatment_response_rate = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
control_response_rate = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()

treatment_response_rate, control_response_rate"}
